_readme: Optional asset manifest. Everything here is OPTIONAL -- delete this file
entirely and the game falls back to procedural vector art, synthesised
audio and the bundled web font, with no errors.
Paths are relative to this assets/ directory.
sprites.key naming convention used by the renderer:
unit_biped | unit_quadruped | unit_dragon
fort_player | fort_enemy
bg_forest | bg_volcano | bg_snow | bg_citadel | bg_arena
Sprite fields:
file      required, image path
frameW    draw width in virtual units (default: image width)
frameH    draw height in virtual units (default: image height)
anchorX   0..1 horizontal anchor within the frame (default 0.5)
anchorY   0..1 vertical anchor, measured from the bottom (default 0.5)
flipOnEnemy  mirror the sprite for enemy units (default true)
cover     stretch-to-fill instead of letterbox, for backgrounds
audio.key: use the same names the engine already fires -- select, button,
coin, evolve, fire, ice, light, wind, earth, poison, biped_die,
quad_die, dragon_die, fire_explode, fort_ruin, stage_start, victory,
defeat.
LICENSE: only add files you have the right to redistribute, and list the
author + license in CREDITS.md. CC0 / CC-BY / OFL are all fine.
